section_summary.extract_value: This section presents further analyses examining nomological validity through correlations between various factors (PEM, RCM, UPE, EPRER, RHSC, BFCC, BV, BC) and BMI, stratified by sex. The text reports that for females, RCM was negatively correlated with EPRER, while BV and BC were positively correlated with BMI; for males, RCM was negatively correlated with RHSC but positively with BMI and PEM. Additionally, sex differences were examined in several measures using CEMS and IES-2 instruments, with significant sex differences found on EPRER, RHSC, and BFCC scores.
